purpose: A-7 R7. Known secret-shaped hits in this repository's reachable history, each dispositioned in writing so the SCHEDULED sweep (scripts/history-sweep.mjs --scheduled) can be red when something new appears instead of red every day. The pre-publication gate (no flag) still reports every hit, dispositioned or not.
contract: A record keys on sha256(pattern |~| file |~| the exact matched line). It excuses THAT line and nothing else: a new secret in the same file, or the same string on a different line, still fires.
Only hashes are stored. The matched text is never written here, so this file cannot itself become a hit.
Every dispositioned hit is PRINTED on every run with its reason. Nothing is hidden, and an entry nobody can justify is a finding rather than a row.
A record that matches nothing FAILS the run as stale. History does not normally lose a line, so that means this file is wrong or history was rewritten; re-derive it rather than deleting the entry.
Rebuild the keys with: node scripts/history-sweep.mjs --list-keys

dispositions.reason: A line in the message of commit 93d220bc quoting a GitHub secret-scanning alert and its dismissal. The value is AWS's own published example key, which appears in this repository exactly twice: in that message, and as this scanner's own positive fixture in scripts/history-sweep.mjs (which ALLOW skips). Verified 2026-09-17 by listing every AWS-shaped line in reachable history with its commit and file; there is no third occurrence and no live counterpart.
